description.text: Tour overview - Study 12 steps Tai Chi form & health Qigong - Highlight scenic spots in Beijing - All meals are organic foods - Join locals and students to better understand their healthy lives - Learn Confucious rituals - learn to do simply farm work and know Chinese famers' life - lectures with diverse topic Itinerary Day 1 8:30-11:30 lecture of tai chi & health maintenance; 12 steps tai chi form study (PartⅠ) 12:30-13:00 lunch at resort 13:30 drive to visit Tian’anmen Square, Palace Museum and Jingshan Imperial Park 17:00 return to the resort 18:00 dinner & review of the class Day 2 8:30 – 11:30 lecture of Self massage; 12 steps tai chi form study (PartⅡ) 12:30 – 13:00 lunch at resort 13:30 drive to visit the Great Wall ( Mu Tian Yun section), practice tai chi on the wall. 17:00 return to the resort 18:00 dinner & review of the class Day 3 8:30-11:30 lecture of health food; 12 steps tai chi form study (PartⅢ) 12:30 – 13:00 lunch at resort 13:30 drive to visit the Summer Palace and old town by rickshaw 17:30 return to the resort 18:30 dinner and review of the class Day 4 8:00 depart for the city, visit the Temple of Heaven, and join the locals to practice tai chi. 12:00 lunch at the local vegetarian restaurant 13:00-14:30 visit the largest Taoist monastery Ba Yun Guan, chat with chief priest, and learn Taoist healthy life. 15:00-17:00 visit China medicine& Herb University have conversation with the students on traditional Chinese healthcare.
